<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Trang-1" id="6081YviowTKci3097NLr"> <mxGraphModel dx="-126" dy="1078" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
title Unified Fashion-MNIST Experiment Pipeline

skinparam backgroundColor transparent
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam defaultFontName Arial
skinparam defaultFontSize 13
skinparam ArrowColor #0F82DF
skinparam ArrowThickness 1.5
skinparam activity {
 BackgroundColor #FFFFFF
 BorderColor #0F82DF
 FontColor #1F2937
 DiamondBackgroundColor #EAF6FC
 DiamondBorderColor #0F82DF
 StartColor #1F2937
 EndColor #1F2937
 BarColor #0F82DF
}

start

' Invisible Unicode spacing keeps all three phase partitions the same width.
partition \"&#8202;&#8195;&#8195;&#8195;&#8195;&#8195;&#8195;&#8195;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Data&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#8195;&#8195;&#8195;&#8195;&#8195;&#8195;&#8195;&#8202;\" {
 :Load Fashion-MNIST;
 :Create train, validation,\nand test splits;
 :Preprocess data;
}

partition \"Model Development\" {
 :Select and initialize model;
 
 ' Placing the activity on the same line as repeat 
 ' removes the empty merge diamond automatically.
 repeat :Train model;
 :Optimize model parameters;
 :Validate model;

 if (Performance worse?) then ([Worse performance])
 goto training_check
 else ([Better performance])
 :Save best checkpoint;
 goto training_check
 endif

 label training_check
 repeat while () is ([Continued]) not ([Stop triggered])

 :Restore best checkpoint;
}

partition \"&#160;&#8195;&#8195;&#8195;&#8195;&#8195;&#8195;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Assessment&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#8195;&#8195;&#8195;&#8195;&#8195;&#8195;&#160;\" {
 :Test model;
 :Evaluate and compare results;
}

stop

@enduml
